title: Waterproof diaper cover and the disposable diaper idea
summary: In 1946 Marion Donovan created a reusable waterproof diaper cover, sold from 1949, and then designed a disposable paper diaper.
why: Paved the way for disposable diapers used by billions.

unsung.contribution: Invented the waterproof diaper cover and an early disposable paper diaper.
unsung.recognition: Manufacturers rejected and laughed at the idea; Victor Mills later capitalised on it with Pampers.
